operators_name_check.name: operators_name_check
operators_name_check.value: char_length("operators"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length("operators"."initials") BETWEEN 1 AND 4

auth_sessions_active_device_idx.name: auth_sessions_active_device_idx
auth_sessions_active_device_idx.where: "auth_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "auth_sessions"."device_id" IS NOT NULL

biometric_tokens_revoke_check.name: biometric_tokens_revoke_check
biometric_tokens_revoke_check.value: ("biometric_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("biometric_tokens"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) AND ("biometric_tokens"."revoke_reason" IS NULL OR "biometric_tokens"."revoke_reason" IN ('DISABLED', 'REENROLLED', 'TOKEN_REUSE', 'DEVICE_REVOKED', 'DEVICE_UNPAIRED', 'USER_DISABLED'))

paired_devices_text_check.name: paired_devices_text_check
paired_devices_text_check.value: char_length("paired_devices"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length("paired_devices"."platform") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND char_length("paired_devices"."app_version") BETWEEN 1 AND 32

paired_devices_lifecycle_check.name: paired_devices_lifecycle_check
paired_devices_lifecycle_check.value: ("paired_devices"."state" = 'PAIRED' AND "paired_devices"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "paired_devices"."revoked_by_operator_id" IS NULL AND "paired_devices"."revoke_reason" IS NULL AND "paired_devices"."unpaired_at" IS NULL) OR ("paired_devices"."state" = 'REVOKED' AND "paired_devices"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "paired_devices"."revoked_by_operator_id" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("paired_devices"."revoke_reason") BETWEEN 5 AND 500 AND "paired_devices"."unpaired_at" IS NULL) OR ("paired_devices"."state" = 'UNPAIRED' AND "paired_devices"."unpaired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "paired_devices"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "paired_devices"."revoked_by_operator_id" IS NULL AND "paired_devices"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)

pairing_codes_closed_check.name: pairing_codes_closed_check
pairing_codes_closed_check.value: ("pairing_codes"."state" = 'ACTIVE') = ("pairing_codes"."closed_at" IS NULL) AND ("pairing_codes"."closed_by_operator_id" IS NULL OR "pairing_codes"."state" = 'CANCELLED')

active_session_time_source_check.name: active_session_time_source_check
active_session_time_source_check.value: ("active_session"."start_time_source" IS NULL OR "active_session"."start_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND ("active_session"."stop_time_source" IS NULL OR "active_session"."stop_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

active_session_json_check.name: active_session_json_check
active_session_json_check.value: jsonb_typeof("active_session"."precheck") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."finalization") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."timeline") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("active_session"."timeline") <= 200 AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."notes") = 'array' AND ("active_session"."fault" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("active_session"."fault") = 'object') AND ("active_session"."recovery" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("active_session"."recovery") = 'object') AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."capture_config") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."audio_source") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("active_session"."transcript_status") = 'object'

session_history_outcome_check.name: session_history_outcome_check
session_history_outcome_check.value: "session_history"."outcome" IN ('SEALED', 'INCOMPLETE') AND ("session_history"."fault_kind" IS NULL OR ("session_history"."outcome" = 'INCOMPLETE' AND "session_history"."fault_kind" IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER', 'MIC_SILENT', 'CAPTURE_FAULT')))

session_history_time_source_check.name: session_history_time_source_check
session_history_time_source_check.value: ("session_history"."start_time_source" IS NULL OR "session_history"."start_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND ("session_history"."end_time_source" IS NULL OR "session_history"."end_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

evidence_items_input_check.name: evidence_items_input_check
evidence_items_input_check.value: "evidence_items"."subject_type" IN ('TERSANGKA', 'SAKSI', 'LAINNYA') AND "evidence_items"."profile_id" IN ('STANDARD_1080P25') AND ("evidence_items"."case_type" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."case_type" IN ('TERSANGKA', 'SAKSI', 'LAINNYA'))

evidence_items_signature_check.name: evidence_items_signature_check
evidence_items_signature_check.value: "evidence_items"."signature_algorithm" IN ('SIMULATED-SHA256', 'Ed25519', 'ECDSA-P256-SHA256') AND (("evidence_items"."signature_algorithm" = 'SIMULATED-SHA256' AND "evidence_items"."signature_simulated") OR ("evidence_items"."signature_algorithm" IN ('Ed25519', 'ECDSA-P256-SHA256') AND NOT "evidence_items"."signature_simulated"))

evidence_items_values_check.name: evidence_items_values_check
evidence_items_values_check.value: "evidence_items"."duration_ms" >= 0 AND "evidence_items"."size_bytes" >= 0 AND "evidence_items"."ended_at" >= "evidence_items"."recorded_at" AND ("evidence_items"."sealed_at" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."sealed_at" >= "evidence_items"."ended_at")

evidence_items_sources_check.name: evidence_items_sources_check
evidence_items_sources_check.value: ("evidence_items"."integrity_source" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."integrity_source" IN ('DEMO_PACKAGE', 'SIMULATED', 'REAL')) AND ("evidence_items"."start_time_source" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."start_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND ("evidence_items"."end_time_source" IS NULL OR "evidence_items"."end_time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

evidence_tracks_values_check.name: evidence_tracks_values_check
evidence_tracks_values_check.value: "evidence_tracks"."size_bytes" >= 0 AND "evidence_tracks"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ("evidence_tracks"."codec" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."codec" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$') AND ("evidence_tracks"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."duration_ms" >= 0) AND ("evidence_tracks"."fragment_count" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."fragment_count" >= 0) AND ("evidence_tracks"."fragment_chain_head" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."fragment_chain_head" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("evidence_tracks"."sha256_plain" IS NULL OR "evidence_tracks"."sha256_plain" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

hardware_snapshot_shapes_check.name: hardware_snapshot_shapes_check
hardware_snapshot_shapes_check.value: jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."cameras") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."mics") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."services") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."other_devices") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."ports") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."tablet_link") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."storage") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."time_status") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."network") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."security") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."health") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."faults") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."software_update") = 'object' AND ("hardware_snapshot"."diagnostics" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("hardware_snapshot"."diagnostics") = 'object')

health_snapshots_cause_check.name: health_snapshots_cause_check
health_snapshots_cause_check.value: "health_snapshots"."cause" IN ('INTERVAL', 'FAULT_RAISED', 'FAULT_CLEARED') AND (("health_snapshots"."cause" = 'INTERVAL') = ("health_snapshots"."fault_kind" IS NULL)) AND ("health_snapshots"."fault_kind" IS NULL OR "health_snapshots"."fault_kind" IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER', 'MIC_SILENT', 'CAPTURE_FAULT'))

health_snapshots_states_check.name: health_snapshots_states_check
health_snapshots_states_check.value: "health_snapshots"."storage_state" IN ('READY', 'LOW', 'FULL') AND "health_snapshots"."time_source" IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC') AND "health_snapshots"."security_state" IN ('READY', 'FAULT') AND ("health_snapshots"."session_state" IS NULL OR "health_snapshots"."session_state" IN ('CREATE', 'PRECHECK', 'ARMED', 'RECORDING', 'STOPPING', 'FINALIZING', 'SEALED', 'FAULT', 'RECOVERY')) AND "health_snapshots"."active_faults" >= 0

capture_devices_text_check.name: capture_devices_text_check
capture_devices_text_check.value: ("capture_devices"."model" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."model") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."firmware" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."firmware") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."address" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."address") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."onvif_uuid" IS NULL OR char_length("capture_devices"."onvif_uuid") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("capture_devices"."mac" IS NULL OR "capture_devices"."mac" ~ '^[0-9A-F:]{17}$')

transcript_chunks_done_check.name: transcript_chunks_done_check
transcript_chunks_done_check.value: ("transcript_chunks"."status" <> 'DONE') OR ("transcript_chunks"."segments" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_chunks"."computed_at" IS NOT NULL)

transcript_chunks_ref_check.name: transcript_chunks_ref_check
transcript_chunks_ref_check.value: ("transcript_chunks"."embedding_ref" IS NULL OR "transcript_chunks"."embedding_ref" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$') AND ("transcript_chunks"."model_id" IS NULL OR "transcript_chunks"."model_id" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$')

transcript_revisions_signature_check.name: transcript_revisions_signature_check
transcript_revisions_signature_check.value: "transcript_revisions"."signature_algorithm" IN ('Ed25519', 'SIMULATED-SHA256') AND (("transcript_revisions"."signature_algorithm" = 'SIMULATED-SHA256' AND "transcript_revisions"."signature_simulated") OR ("transcript_revisions"."signature_algorithm" IN ('Ed25519') AND NOT "transcript_revisions"."signature_simulated"))

stt_config_credential_check.name: stt_config_credential_check
stt_config_credential_check.value:
("stt_config"."credential_kind" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."credential_ref" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."secret_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."nonce" IS NULL)
        OR ("stt_config"."credential_kind" = 'REFERENCE' AND "stt_config"."credential_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "stt_config"."secret_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "stt_config"."nonce" IS NULL)
        OR ("stt_config"."credential_kind" = 'ENCRYPTED' AND "stt_config"."credential_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "stt_config"."secret_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "stt_config"."nonce" IS NOT NULL)
